title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA’S GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF EID-E-MILAD-UN-NABI
body_text:
The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu in her message on the eve of Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi says: -
“On the auspicious occasion of Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi, I extend my warm greetings and best wishes to all fellow citizens living in India and abroad, especially the Muslim brothers and sisters.
The festival of Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi is an occasion to recall the preachings of Prophet Muhammad. His teachings inspire us to follow the path of pious conduct and dutifulness.
May the noble ideals of Prophet Muhammad inspire us to contribute actively towards building an inclusive and developed India”.
****
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: President Droupadi Murmu issued a message extending greetings to citizens, especially the Muslim community, on the eve of Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi. She noted that the festival commemorates the teachings of Prophet Muhammad, which inspire pious conduct and dutifulness, and expressed hope that his ideals would inspire progress towards an inclusive and developed India.
enrichment.context: This is a routine ceremonial greeting message issued by the President's Secretariat, a practice followed for major religious festivals of all faiths celebrated in India as part of the constitutional head of state's symbolic role in reflecting India's pluralistic and secular ethos. Such messages carry no policy content or administrative decisions and are issued annually on similar occasions.
